_comment: How catalogue telescope/instrument strings map to YSE telescopes and instruments (#894, #1003). `manage.py catalog_instruments --census <OSC_DIR>/sne-* --load` plans every string found in the catalogue and, with --apply, creates what is missing and one alias row per string. Order: (1) the first rule below that matches; (2) an existing YSE instrument of that name; (3) automatic: telescope and instrument given -> Telescope/Instrument, one given -> X/X, 'Telescope - Instrument' in one field -> split. Strings in `unknown` stay on the Unknown instrument. A rule's `telescope` / `instrument` patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the whole telescope / instrument string, and `any` is searched in either; a rule matches when all the patterns it gives match. `existing` names a YSE instrument to use when there is exactly one of that name (so catalogue data join YSE's own); otherwise target_telescope / target_instrument are created. \1 in a target is the rule's first group. Ryan's mappings, 2026-11-16.
